objects.definition: typedef union LZ4_stream_u LZ4_stream_t;  /* incomplete type (defined later) */

functions.name: LZ4_versionNumber
functions.signature: int LZ4_versionNumber(void)
functions.description: Returns the LZ4 library version number as an integer (useful to check dll/shared library version). Typical usage: compare returned value against a known version constant.
requirements: No arguments required.
Thread-safe to call for version query (no state).
Return value is a positive integer encoding major/minor/patch.

functions.name: LZ4_versionString
functions.signature: const char* LZ4_versionString(void)
functions.description: Returns the LZ4 library version as a string. Intended for diagnostic or version checks against the loaded library.
requirements: Caller must not free or modify the returned string pointer.
String remains valid for the lifetime of the library.

functions.name: LZ4_compress_default
functions.signature: int LZ4_compress_default(const char* src, char* dst, int srcSize, int dstCapacity)
functions.description: Compresses src buffer into dst. Guaranteed to succeed if dstCapacity >= LZ4_compressBound(srcSize). Returns number of bytes written to dst, or 0 if compression fails (dst too small).
requirements: src must point to at least srcSize bytes of readable memory.
dst must point to an allocated buffer of size >= dstCapacity.
srcSize must be >= 0 and <= LZ4_MAX_INPUT_SIZE (0x7E000000).
dstCapacity must be >= 0; if too small, function returns 0 and dst content is invalid.
Function does not read/write out of provided buffers.

functions.name: LZ4_decompress_safe
functions.signature: int LZ4_decompress_safe(const char* src, char* dst, int compressedSize, int dstCapacity)
functions.description: Decompresses a single LZ4 block from src into dst safely with bound checks. Returns number of bytes decompressed (<= dstCapacity), or a negative value on error (dst too small or malformed input).
requirements: src must point to exactly compressedSize bytes of a complete compressed block.
dst must be allocated with size >= dstCapacity.
compressedSize must be >= 0.
dstCapacity must be >= 0.
Handles malformed or malicious input by returning a negative error code; caller must check for negative return.

functions.name: LZ4_compressBound
functions.signature: int LZ4_compressBound(int inputSize)
functions.description: Returns the maximum compressed size for a worst-case input of length inputSize. Use to allocate dst buffer capacity. Returns 0 if inputSize is invalid (negative or > LZ4_MAX_INPUT_SIZE).
requirements: inputSize must be >= 0 and <= LZ4_MAX_INPUT_SIZE (0x7E000000).
Pure utility: does not read memory.

functions.name: LZ4_compress_fast
functions.signature: int LZ4_compress_fast(const char* src, char* dst, int srcSize, int dstCapacity, int acceleration)
functions.description: Compresses src into dst like LZ4_compress_default but with a tunable acceleration factor (higher is faster, lower ratio). Values <= 0 are treated as default (1). Returns compressed size or 0 if it can’t fit in dst.
requirements: src must point to at least srcSize bytes readable.
dst must be allocated to at least dstCapacity bytes.
srcSize must be >= 0 and <= LZ4_MAX_INPUT_SIZE.
dstCapacity must be >= 0; if too small, returns 0.
acceleration <= 0 is allowed and treated as default (1).
Caller must handle 0 return as compression failure.

functions.name: LZ4_sizeofState
functions.signature: int LZ4_sizeofState(void)
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes required to hold an external compression state object for use with LZ4_compress_fast_extState and related APIs.
requirements: Utility query; no arguments.
Returned size should be used to allocate an 8-byte aligned state buffer.

functions.name: LZ4_compress_fast_extState
functions.signature: int LZ4_compress_fast_extState(void* state, const char* src, char* dst, int srcSize, int dstCapacity, int acceleration)
functions.description: Compresses src into dst using a caller-provided external state buffer. Equivalent to LZ4_compress_fast but avoids internal allocation; state must be pre-allocated with LZ4_sizeofState and 8-byte aligned.
requirements: state must point to a writable buffer of at least LZ4_sizeofState() bytes aligned to 8-byte boundaries.
src must point to at least srcSize readable bytes.
dst must be allocated to at least dstCapacity bytes.
srcSize must be >= 0 and <= LZ4_MAX_INPUT_SIZE.
dstCapacity must be >= 0.
acceleration <= 0 is allowed and treated as default (1).
Returns 0 if output cannot fit; caller must handle 0.

functions.name: LZ4_compress_destSize
functions.signature: int LZ4_compress_destSize(const char* src, char* dst, int* srcSizePtr, int targetDstSize)
functions.description: Compresses as much of src as will fit into dst of size targetDstSize. On return, *srcSizePtr is updated to the number of input bytes consumed. Returns number of bytes written to dst, or 0 on failure.
requirements: src must be readable for at least the original *srcSizePtr bytes.
dst must be allocated to at least targetDstSize bytes.
srcSizePtr must be non-NULL and point to an integer input size; it will be updated (new value <= old).
targetDstSize must be >= 0.
Caller must check return value; 0 indicates failure.

functions.name: LZ4_decompress_fast
functions.signature: int LZ4_decompress_fast(const char* src, char* dst, int originalSize)
functions.description: Unsafe fast decompressor when original uncompressed size is known. Returns the number of bytes read from src (compressed size) or a negative value on malformed input. Does not guard against out-of-bounds writes for malicious input; use only in trusted environments.
requirements: dst must be allocated with size >= originalSize.
originalSize must be >= 0.
src must contain a complete compressed block; function assumes src buffer is at least the compressed size (it doesn’t take compressed size as input).
Caller must check for negative return indicating malformed input.
Use only with trusted input; not protected against malicious data.

functions.name: LZ4_decompress_safe_partial
functions.signature: int LZ4_decompress_safe_partial(const char* src, char* dst, int srcSize, int targetOutputSize, int dstCapacity)
functions.description: Safely decompresses up to dstCapacity bytes and stops after at least targetOutputSize bytes have been produced (may produce slightly more). Returns number of bytes decoded into dst, possibly less than targetOutputSize if compressed block is smaller, or negative on error.
requirements: src must point to exactly srcSize bytes of compressed data for a full block.
dst must be allocated with size >= dstCapacity.
srcSize, targetOutputSize, and dstCapacity must be >= 0.
Caller must check return; negative indicates malformed input or insufficient dst.
Decoded bytes may be < targetOutputSize if the block contains less data.

functions.name: LZ4_createStream
functions.signature: LZ4_stream_t* LZ4_createStream(void)
functions.description: Allocates and initializes a new LZ4_stream_t compression context for streaming compression.
requirements: Returns NULL on allocation failure; caller must check for NULL.
Context must be freed with LZ4_freeStream.

functions.name: LZ4_freeStream
functions.signature: int LZ4_freeStream(LZ4_stream_t* streamPtr)
functions.description: Releases memory for a streaming compression context previously created by LZ4_createStream. Returns an int status (implementation typically 0/other).
requirements: streamPtr may be NULL or a valid pointer returned by LZ4_createStream.
Do not use streamPtr after freeing.
Caller should check return value for success (non-specified exact semantics).

functions.name: LZ4_resetStream
functions.signature: void LZ4_resetStream(LZ4_stream_t* streamPtr)
functions.description: Resets an existing LZ4_stream_t to start a new compression stream. Allows reusing the same context for multiple independent streams.
requirements: streamPtr must be a valid pointer to an LZ4_stream_t (created by LZ4_createStream or statically allocated to correct layout).
Must be called before starting a new independent compression if prior state is not desired.

functions.name: LZ4_loadDict
functions.signature: int LZ4_loadDict(LZ4_stream_t* streamPtr, const char* dictionary, int dictSize)
functions.description: Loads a static dictionary into a compression stream, replacing any prior history. Returns the dictionary size (<= 64 KB). Loading dictSize == 0 is allowed and acts like reset.
requirements: streamPtr must be a valid compression stream.
dictionary may be NULL if dictSize == 0; otherwise must point to at least dictSize bytes readable.
dictSize must be >= 0; effective dictionary size returned is <= 64 KB.
Any previous data/history in stream is discarded.

functions.name: LZ4_compress_fast_continue
functions.signature: int LZ4_compress_fast_continue(LZ4_stream_t* streamPtr, const char* src, char* dst, int srcSize, int dstCapacity, int acceleration)
functions.description: Streaming compression using prior blocks’ history for better ratio. Requires that the previous 64 KB of compressed data remain present and unmodified in memory. Returns compressed size or 0 if it can’t fit in dst.
requirements: streamPtr must be a valid stream previously used or reset/initialized.
The last 64 KB of previously compressed data must remain present and unmodified in memory at their original locations.
src must be readable for srcSize bytes.
dst must be allocated to at least dstCapacity bytes.
srcSize must be >= 0 and <= LZ4_MAX_INPUT_SIZE.
dstCapacity must be >= 0.
acceleration <= 0 treated as default (1).
On 0 return, stream status becomes invalid; it can only be reset or freed before further use.

functions.name: LZ4_saveDict
functions.signature: int LZ4_saveDict(LZ4_stream_t* streamPtr, char* safeBuffer, int maxDictSize)
functions.description: Saves up to the last 64 KB of relevant history from the stream into safeBuffer to preserve it when original memory cannot be kept. Faster than memcpy + LZ4_loadDict. Returns number of bytes saved (<= maxDictSize), or 0 on error.
requirements: streamPtr must be a valid compression stream.
safeBuffer must point to a writable buffer of at least maxDictSize bytes.
maxDictSize must be >= 0.
Returned size is <= 64 KB and <= maxDictSize; 0 indicates error.

functions.name: LZ4_createStreamDecode
functions.signature: LZ4_streamDecode_t* LZ4_createStreamDecode(void)
functions.description: Allocates and initializes a streaming decompression tracking structure for bufferless synchronous API.
requirements: Returns NULL on allocation failure; caller must check.
Must be freed with LZ4_freeStreamDecode when done.

functions.name: LZ4_freeStreamDecode
functions.signature: int LZ4_freeStreamDecode(LZ4_streamDecode_t* LZ4_stream)
functions.description: Frees a streaming decompression tracking structure created by LZ4_createStreamDecode. Returns an int status (implementation-specific).
requirements: LZ4_stream may be NULL or a valid pointer from LZ4_createStreamDecode.
Do not use the pointer after freeing.
Caller should check return value for success (exact semantics unspecified).

functions.name: LZ4_setStreamDecode
functions.signature: int LZ4_setStreamDecode(LZ4_streamDecode_t* LZ4_streamDecode, const char* dictionary, int dictSize)
functions.description: Initializes or resets a streaming decompression context, optionally setting a dictionary. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.
requirements: LZ4_streamDecode must be a valid pointer to a decode stream.
dictionary may be NULL or dictSize == 0 for reset; otherwise must point to at least dictSize bytes readable.
dictSize must be >= 0.
Caller must check return: 1 means OK, 0 means error.

functions.name: LZ4_decompress_safe_continue
functions.signature: int LZ4_decompress_safe_continue(LZ4_streamDecode_t* LZ4_streamDecode, const char* src, char* dst, int srcSize, int dstCapacity)
functions.description: Safely decompresses a block in streaming mode using prior decoded data as history. Returns number of bytes decoded (<= dstCapacity) or negative on error. Requires last up to 64 KB of previously decoded data remain available and unmodified in place.
requirements: LZ4_streamDecode must be a valid decode stream initialized for the sequence of blocks.
src must point to exactly srcSize bytes of a complete block.
dst must be allocated to at least dstCapacity bytes.
srcSize and dstCapacity must be >= 0.
The last 64 KB of previously decoded data must remain available and unmodified at their decoded locations (or all decoded so far if < 64 KB).
Caller must check for negative return indicating error.

functions.name: LZ4_decompress_fast_continue
functions.signature: int LZ4_decompress_fast_continue(LZ4_streamDecode_t* LZ4_streamDecode, const char* src, char* dst, int originalSize)
functions.description: Fast (unsafe) streaming decompression of a block when originalSize is known. Returns bytes read from src (compressed size) or negative on malformed input. Requires previously decoded data to remain available and unmodified in place.
requirements: LZ4_streamDecode must be a valid decode stream initialized for streaming.
dst must be allocated with size >= originalSize.
src must contain a complete block; function assumes src buffer is at least compressed size.
originalSize must be >= 0.
Not protected against malicious input; use only in trusted environments.
Previously decoded last 64 KB must remain available and unmodified.

functions.name: LZ4_decompress_safe_usingDict
functions.signature: int LZ4_decompress_safe_usingDict(const char* src, char* dst, int srcSize, int dstCapcity, const char* dictStart, int dictSize)
functions.description: Safely decompresses a block using an explicit external dictionary without requiring a decode stream. Returns number of bytes decoded (<= dstCapcity) or negative on error.
requirements: src must point to exactly srcSize bytes of compressed data.
dst must be allocated to at least dstCapcity bytes.
srcSize, dstCapcity, and dictSize must be >= 0.
dictStart may be NULL if dictSize == 0; otherwise must point to at least dictSize bytes readable.
Caller must check for negative return on error.

functions.name: LZ4_decompress_fast_usingDict
functions.signature: int LZ4_decompress_fast_usingDict(const char* src, char* dst, int originalSize, const char* dictStart, int dictSize)
functions.description: Fast (unsafe) decompression using an explicit dictionary when originalSize is known. Returns bytes read from src (compressed size) or negative on malformed input.
requirements: dst must be allocated with size >= originalSize.
originalSize and dictSize must be >= 0.
src must contain a complete block; function assumes src buffer is at least compressed size.
dictStart may be NULL if dictSize == 0; otherwise must point to dictSize bytes readable.
Not safe against malicious input; use only in trusted environments.
Caller must check for negative return on malformed input.

functions.name: LZ4_resetStream_fast
functions.signature: void LZ4_resetStream_fast(LZ4_stream_t* streamPtr)
functions.description: [Static linking only] Quickly prepares a stream for new compression when it is already in a known coherent state, avoiding an expensive full reset.
requirements: Only available/valid when LZ4_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY is defined and stream layout matches header.

streamPtr must be a valid LZ4_stream_t in a known valid state as described in the header (e.g., after LZ4_createStream, LZ4_resetStream, memset to 0 of correct size, after successful compression, or after fast reset on a valid stream).
Do not use if stream is in an indeterminate state unless a full-resetting function has been called.

functions.name: LZ4_compress_fast_extState_fastReset
functions.signature: int LZ4_compress_fast_extState_fastReset(void* state, const char* src, char* dst, int srcSize, int dstCapacity, int acceleration)
functions.description: [Static linking only] Variant of LZ4_compress_fast_extState that performs a fast reset of the provided state (as per LZ4_resetStream_fast) before compression, avoiding a full initialization.
requirements: state must point to a correctly initialized/compatible state buffer (size >= LZ4_sizeofState(), 8-byte aligned).
Only safe to call if the state is already in a correctly initialized state per LZ4_resetStream_fast contract.
src/dst, sizes, and acceleration requirements are the same as LZ4_compress_fast_extState.
Caller must handle 0 return when dst is too small.

functions.name: LZ4_attach_dictionary
functions.signature: void LZ4_attach_dictionary(LZ4_stream_t* working_stream, const LZ4_stream_t* dictionary_stream)
functions.description: [Static linking only] Efficiently attaches a preloaded dictionary stream to a working compression stream without copying. The attachment lasts only for the first subsequent compression call; then it is cleared.
requirements: working_stream must be a valid compression stream.
dictionary_stream must be a stream prepared by LZ4_loadDict(), or NULL to detach any existing dictionary.
If a dictionary is attached, it replaces any pre-existing stream history.
The dictionary stream and its source buffer must remain accessible and unchanged through the completion of the first subsequent compression call.

functions.name: LZ4_compress
functions.signature: int LZ4_compress(const char* source, char* dest, int sourceSize)
functions.description: Deprecated. Legacy single-call compression equivalent to LZ4_compress_default with implicit unlimited dst size. Use LZ4_compress_default instead.
requirements: source must be readable for sourceSize bytes.
dest must be sufficiently large to hold the compressed data (no explicit capacity parameter provided).
sourceSize must be >= 0 and <= LZ4_MAX_INPUT_SIZE.
Caller must handle return value as compressed size or 0 on failure (legacy semantics).

functions.name: LZ4_compress_limitedOutput
functions.signature: int LZ4_compress_limitedOutput(const char* source, char* dest, int sourceSize, int maxOutputSize)
functions.description: Deprecated. Legacy compression with explicit maximum output size. Returns compressed size or 0 if it cannot fit within maxOutputSize. Use LZ4_compress_default instead.
requirements: source must be readable for sourceSize bytes.
dest must be allocated to at least maxOutputSize bytes.
sourceSize must be >= 0 and <= LZ4_MAX_INPUT_SIZE.
maxOutputSize must be >= 0.
Caller must handle 0 return meaning output didn’t fit.

functions.name: LZ4_compress_withState
functions.signature: int LZ4_compress_withState(void* state, const char* source, char* dest, int inputSize)
functions.description: Deprecated. Legacy compression using an external state buffer. Use LZ4_compress_fast_extState instead.
requirements: state must point to a writable buffer of at least LZ4_sizeofState() bytes and 8-byte aligned.
source must be readable for inputSize bytes.
dest must be large enough for compressed data (no explicit capacity parameter).
inputSize must be >= 0 and <= LZ4_MAX_INPUT_SIZE.

functions.name: LZ4_compress_limitedOutput_withState
functions.signature: int LZ4_compress_limitedOutput_withState(void* state, const char* source, char* dest, int inputSize, int maxOutputSize)
functions.description: Deprecated. Legacy compression using external state with a maximum output size. Use LZ4_compress_fast_extState instead.
requirements: state must be a writable buffer of size >= LZ4_sizeofState() and 8-byte aligned.
source must be readable for inputSize bytes.
dest must be allocated to at least maxOutputSize bytes.
inputSize must be >= 0 and <= LZ4_MAX_INPUT_SIZE.
maxOutputSize must be >= 0.
Returns 0 if output cannot fit; caller must handle 0.

functions.name: LZ4_compress_continue
functions.signature: int LZ4_compress_continue(LZ4_stream_t* LZ4_streamPtr, const char* source, char* dest, int inputSize)
functions.description: Deprecated streaming compression API. Use LZ4_compress_fast_continue instead.
requirements: LZ4_streamPtr must be a valid compression stream.
source must be readable for inputSize bytes.
dest must be large enough for compressed output (no explicit capacity provided).
inputSize must be >= 0 and <= LZ4_MAX_INPUT_SIZE.
Caller must handle 0 return on failure.

functions.name: LZ4_compress_limitedOutput_continue
functions.signature: int LZ4_compress_limitedOutput_continue(LZ4_stream_t* LZ4_streamPtr, const char* source, char* dest, int inputSize, int maxOutputSize)
functions.description: Deprecated streaming compression with output size limit. Use LZ4_compress_fast_continue instead.
requirements: LZ4_streamPtr must be a valid compression stream.
source must be readable for inputSize bytes.
dest must be allocated to at least maxOutputSize bytes.
inputSize must be >= 0 and <= LZ4_MAX_INPUT_SIZE.
maxOutputSize must be >= 0.
Returns 0 if output cannot fit; caller must handle 0.

functions.name: LZ4_uncompress
functions.signature: int LZ4_uncompress(const char* source, char* dest, int outputSize)
functions.description: Deprecated. Legacy fast decompression when original size is known. Equivalent to LZ4_decompress_fast. Use LZ4_decompress_fast instead.
requirements: dest must be allocated with size >= outputSize.
source must contain a complete compressed block.
outputSize must be >= 0.
Not protected against malicious input; caller must check negative return for malformed input (legacy behavior parallels fast decompressor).

functions.name: LZ4_uncompress_unknownOutputSize
functions.signature: int LZ4_uncompress_unknownOutputSize(const char* source, char* dest, int isize, int maxOutputSize)
functions.description: Deprecated. Legacy safe decompressor when compressed size and maximum output size are known. Equivalent to LZ4_decompress_safe. Use LZ4_decompress_safe instead.
requirements: source must point to exactly isize bytes of compressed data.
dest must be allocated to at least maxOutputSize bytes.
isize and maxOutputSize must be >= 0.
Caller must check negative return for errors (malformed input or too small dst).

functions.name: LZ4_create
functions.signature: void* LZ4_create(char* inputBuffer)
functions.description: Deprecated obsolete streaming function. Preserved for compatibility; creates an old-style streaming state but no longer retains history between calls. Use LZ4_createStream instead.
requirements: inputBuffer parameter is obsolete; may be ignored by implementation.
Caller must free with matching legacy API if used; prefer modern streaming APIs.
Functionality is degraded; do not rely on history retention.

functions.name: LZ4_sizeofStreamState
functions.signature: int LZ4_sizeofStreamState(void)
functions.description: Deprecated obsolete streaming helper. Returns size of old streaming state. Use modern streaming APIs instead.
requirements: Utility query; no arguments.
Only for legacy code paths; size semantics are for obsolete state layout.

functions.name: LZ4_resetStreamState
functions.signature: int LZ4_resetStreamState(void* state, char* inputBuffer)
functions.description: Deprecated obsolete streaming reset. No longer retains history between calls. Use LZ4_resetStream/LZ4_loadDict instead.
requirements: state must point to a legacy stream state buffer of size indicated by LZ4_sizeofStreamState.
inputBuffer parameter is obsolete; may be ignored.
Caller must check return for success (semantics unspecified).

functions.name: LZ4_slideInputBuffer
functions.signature: char* LZ4_slideInputBuffer(void* state)
functions.description: Deprecated obsolete streaming helper. Returns a pointer for where to continue input in a legacy streaming workflow. Functionality is degraded; do not use for new code. Use LZ4_saveDict/LZ4_loadDict with modern streams instead.
requirements: state must be a pointer to a legacy stream state created via obsolete APIs.
Returned pointer must be treated per legacy workflow; semantics are obsolete/limited.

functions.name: LZ4_decompress_safe_withPrefix64k
functions.signature: int LZ4_decompress_safe_withPrefix64k(const char* src, char* dst, int compressedSize, int maxDstSize)
functions.description: Deprecated. Safe decompression assuming a 64 KB prefix dictionary from previously decoded data. Use LZ4_decompress_safe_usingDict instead.
requirements: src must point to exactly compressedSize bytes of compressed data.
dst must be allocated to at least maxDstSize bytes.
compressedSize and maxDstSize must be >= 0.
Caller must check for negative return indicating error.

functions.name: LZ4_decompress_fast_withPrefix64k
functions.signature: int LZ4_decompress_fast_withPrefix64k(const char* src, char* dst, int originalSize)
functions.description: Deprecated. Fast (unsafe) decompression assuming a 64 KB prefix dictionary from previously decoded data. Use LZ4_decompress_fast_usingDict instead.
requirements: dst must be allocated with size >= originalSize.
src must contain a complete block; function assumes src buffer is at least compressed size.
originalSize must be >= 0.
Not protected against malicious input; caller must check for negative return on malformed input.

functions.name: LZ_Uncompress
functions.signature: unsigned int LZ_Uncompress(const unsigned char* in, unsigned char* out, unsigned int insize)
functions.description: LZ77 decoder interface (from lz.h). Decompresses data from in to out. Details such as required out size are not documented here; callers must follow the implementation’s contract. Returns number of output bytes written.
requirements: in must point to at least insize bytes of compressed data.
out must point to a sufficiently large writable buffer to hold the decompressed output (size not specified in header).
insize is the exact size of input data in bytes.

Caller must rely on format/implementation specifics to know necessary output capacity.

data_types.description: A raw byte buffer with no specific format constraints. May contain any 8-bit values including NUL bytes; used as generic input for compression or dictionary buffers.

A byte sequence representing a single LZ4 compressed block as produced by LZ4 compression functions. It can be safely or unsafely decompressed by corresponding LZ4 decompression APIs; not a framed format, just the raw block data.

generators.generator:
import random
import struct

# This generator produces valid single LZ4 raw blocks. It implements a minimal
# encoder that emits sequences of literals and matches with proper token, length
# extras, and 2-byte offsets. It aims to cover varied patterns while keeping
# inputs valid and within 4096 bytes.

MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES = 4096


def _rand_bytes(rng: random.Random, n: int) -> bytes:
    return bytes(rng.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(n))


def _gen_plain_patterns(rng: random.Random, size: int) -> bytes:
    modes = [
        "random",
        "zeros",
        "repeating_small",
        "ascii_text",
        "incremental",
        "highly_repetitive",
    ]
    mode = rng.choice(modes)
    if size == 0:
        return b""
    if mode == "random":
        return _rand_bytes(rng, size)
    if mode == "zeros":
        return b"\x00" * size
    if mode == "repeating_small":
        pat_len = rng.randrange(1, 16)
        pat = _rand_bytes(rng, pat_len)
        return (pat * (size // len(pat) + 1))[:size]
    if mode == "ascii_text":
        words = [b"LZ4", b"compress", b"data", b"block", b"stream", b"dictionary", b"test"]
        out = bytearray()
        while len(out) < size:
            w = rng.choice(words)
            out.extend(w)
            out.append(ord(' '))
        return bytes(out[:size])
    if mode == "incremental":
        base = rng.randrange(0, 256)
        return bytes((base + i) % 256 for i in range(size))
    if mode == "highly_repetitive":
        c = rng.randrange(0, 256)
        return bytes([c]) * size
    return _rand_bytes(rng, size)


def _emit_token(lit_len: int, match_len_nibble: int) -> bytes:
    lit_n = min(lit_len, 15)
    mat_n = min(match_len_nibble, 15)
    return bytes([(lit_n << 4) | mat_n])


def _emit_len_extra(base_len: int) -> bytes:
    # base_len is the literal length or (match_len - 4). If >= 15, emit extras.
    out = bytearray()
    if base_len < 15:
        return bytes(out)
    rem = base_len - 15
    while rem >= 255:
        out.append(255)
        rem -= 255
    out.append(rem)
    return bytes(out)


def _encode_sequences_from_plain(rng: random.Random, plain: bytes) -> bytes:
    i = 0
    out = bytearray()
    produced = bytearray()  # decoded so far
    n = len(plain)

    if n == 0:
        # Emit a minimal empty block: token 0 with no literals/match
        out.append(0)
        return bytes(out)

    while i < n and len(out) < MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES - 8:
        # Decide whether to add a match after literals
        choose_match = (len(produced) >= 4) and (n - i >= 4) and (rng.random() < 0.6)

        # Pick literal run length safely
        max_lit = n - i
        if max_lit <= 0:
            break
        if choose_match:
            # small literal prefix before a match
            hi = min(32, max_lit)
            # randrange requires start < stop; ensure range is valid
            if hi <= 1:
                lit_len = 0
            else:
                lit_len = rng.randrange(0, hi)
        else:
            # emit larger literal chunk; ensure bounds valid
            if rng.random() < 0.5:
                hi = min(max_lit, 200)
                if hi <= 1:
                    lit_len = max_lit  # either 0 or 1
                else:
                    lit_len = rng.randrange(1, hi)
            else:
                lit_len = max_lit

        literals = plain[i:i + lit_len]
        i += lit_len

        if not choose_match or i >= n or len(produced) < 4 or (n - i) < 4:
            # Literal-only sequence (no match)
            token = _emit_token(len(literals), 0)
            out += token
            out += _emit_len_extra(len(literals))
            out += literals
            produced += literals
            continue

        # Emit a match after literals
        # Choose valid offset in [1, len(produced)]
        max_off = len(produced)
        off = rng.randrange(1, max_off + 1)

        # Choose match length mlen >= 4 and <= remaining
        remaining = n - i
        if remaining < 4:
            # fallback: turn into literal-only
            token = _emit_token(len(literals), 0)
            out += token
            out += _emit_len_extra(len(literals))
            out += literals
            produced += literals
            continue

        if rng.random() < 0.5:
            mlen = rng.randrange(4, min(20, remaining) + 1)
        else:
            mlen = min(remaining, 4 + 15 + rng.randrange(0, 512))

        # Compose sequence
        token = _emit_token(len(literals), mlen - 4)
        out += token
        out += _emit_len_extra(len(literals))
        out += literals
        out += struct.pack('<H', off)
        out += _emit_len_extra(mlen - 4)

        # Simulate matched bytes appended to produced
        src_pos = len(produced) - off
        # Build match using overlapping semantics
        match_bytes = bytearray()
        # Start from source window
        while len(match_bytes) < mlen:
            take = min(off, mlen - len(match_bytes))
            chunk = produced[src_pos:src_pos + take]
            if len(chunk) < take:
                # If produced is smaller than needed (shouldn't happen due to off <= len(produced)),
                # pad conservatively with already built bytes to mimic overlap
                chunk = (chunk + match_bytes)[:take]
            match_bytes.extend(chunk)
        produced += match_bytes

        # Do not advance i for match (as matches refer to already produced data)
        # To simulate realistic compression, advance input by mlen
        i += mlen

    # If any remaining input not covered by sequences, flush as a final literal-only sequence
    if i < n:
        remaining = plain[i:]
        token = _emit_token(len(remaining), 0)
        out += token
        out += _emit_len_extra(len(remaining))
        out += remaining

    return bytes(out[:MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES])


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    # Choose original size similar to fuzzers (<= 1500)
    size_choices = [0, rng.randrange(1, 64), rng.randrange(64, 300), rng.randrange(300, 1200), rng.randrange(1200, 1500)]
    orig_size = rng.choice(size_choices)

    plain = _gen_plain_patterns(rng, orig_size)

    block = _encode_sequences_from_plain(rng, plain)

    if not block:
        # Fallback: encode plain as one literal sequence
        lit_len = len(plain)
        token = _emit_token(lit_len, 0)
        out = bytearray(token)
        out += _emit_len_extra(lit_len)
        out += plain
        block = bytes(out)

    return block[:MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES]
